Proof of Achievement for Milestone 2: Final Product Development and Fine-tuning
We are pleased to submit the following evidence for the completion of Milestone 2, demonstrating that we have met all the specified requirements and acceptance criteria.
Optimized & Enhanced Tool
We have released a refined version of the prototype, transitioning from a simple bash script to an extensive Python toolchain. This new version has undergone thorough fine-tuning and optimization, making it ready to be tested in limited production environments.
・Release Version: Beta Release v0.9
・GitHub Repository: MuesliSwap Sockets Across Machines

Key Enhancements:
・Automatic Error Recovery: The tool now automatically detects and recovers from errors such as already mapped ports or unexpected disconnects, minimizing user intervention.
・Security & Reliability: Utilizes SSH for secure tunneling, ensuring encrypted and authenticated communication between client and server.
・User-Friendly Experience: Requires minimal setup; the tool works out-of-the-box with default settings, streamlining the user experience.
・Comes-with-Batteries: Bundled with all necessary dependencies, eliminating the need for additional user setup.

Comprehensive Documentation
The public repository contains thorough documentation and detailed instructions, enabling users to set up and utilize the tool effectively.
・README: Detailed installation, setup, and usage instructions are provided in the README.md.
・Contributing Guide: The README.md additionally outlines how users can engage with the project, report issues, and contribute.
・Release Notes: The Beta Release v0.9 Notes detail the enhancements made, demonstrating the refinement and readiness of the tool for limited production use.
・Troubleshooting Guide: Common issues and resolutions are documented to assist users in resolving problems independently.

Video Demonstration of Functionality
A video showcasing the tool’s functionality and interactions with the Cardano Nodeser

Closing Out Report: Public Beta Recap & Final Release
Project Overview
The MuesliSwap Sockets Across Machines project has reached its final milestone, completing the Public Beta Launch phase. This phase prioritized delivering an optimized, reliable, and user-friendly tool designed to streamline remote socket handling for Cardano developers. Based on extensive user feedback, the product has been refined with advanced optimizations, flexible configuration options, and detailed documentation, preparing it for broader release.
Milestone Deliverables
1. Final Optimized Product:
・ Extensive optimizations ensure the tool is efficient, robust, and reliable across different environments.
・ User feedback prompted the addition of optional sudo usage via environment variables, improved argument handling, and clear guidance on supported mapping scenarios, enhancing usability and accessibility.

2. Structured Beta Program:
・ A successful beta program allowed users to explore the tool, assess its functionalities, and provide constructive feedback, which shaped the final refinements. 
・ Documentation of beta feedback and corresponding adjustments can be found here: Beta Program Report
・ Link to collected feedback: Beta Feedback Spreadsheet

3. Updated Documentation:
・The documentation has been fully updated to provide clear and concise instructions on installation, usage, and troubleshooting, with special attention to optional sudo configurations and supported usage scenarios.

Milestone Acceptance Criteria
1. Product Reliability and Efficiency:
・ Final product meets expected performance standards, providing smooth operation and reliability in diverse environments.
・ All features are fully operational, with improved handling of complex setups and configurations based on user feedback.

2. Comprehensive and Clear Documentation:
・The updated documentation ensures a smooth onboarding experience, with detailed instructions covering every major feature and configuration.

3. Successful
